reading.body:
Covariant reported selling $23,385,666 in a Form D offering that began on November 3, 2022 and was filed with the SEC on June 14, 2023.

The filing is an initial Form D, not an amendment, and the amount sold equals the total offering amount. Covariant is listed as a for-profit startup with a website at covariant.ai, but the dataset records no products, no lawsuits, and no regulatory cases for the company.

This data does not show what the capital was used for. It contains no information about compute purchases, data centers, power contracts, or grid connections, so it cannot support any claim about how this funding relates to AI infrastructure constraints.

profile_text.body:
Covariant is a for-profit startup, according to the company's own site at covariant.ai. The site text available for the company consists of its name alone, with no description of what it makes or does.
